memory_model: asynchronous external IMEM handshake model and external_dmem_bram; both scaled to 16 KiB

controlled_variables.replacement: invalid way first, then per-set LRU
controlled_variables.interval: retired benchmark markers, otherwise main to program_done
controlled_variables.initial_state: reset before each run; initialization before the interval may warm caches
controlled_variables.imem_refill: ready in the request cycle, matching the boot-complete board IMEM interface; UART boot is not simulated
controlled_variables.scope: cycle-accurate simulation, not physical-board elapsed time
controlled_variables.latency_scope: extra serialized request wait; not a DDR controller or bandwidth model
controlled_variables.counter_semantics: dcache_misses counts primary misses; data_line_fills counts completed backing refills

publication_note: Embedded run hashes identify original files; publication.json records normalized-copy hashes.
